name: Divine Dragon (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): True dragon

Benefit(s): You replace your sorcerer spell casting levels with levels of divine spellcasting as per the cleric class.

You select two domains as per a cleric and channel energy as a cleric with a level equal to its caster level.
